![What's new in Hamstr 0.6.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/Hamstr/v0.6.0/docs/images/releases/v0.6.0.png)

Hamstr 0.6.0 brings a dedicated music player, a queue you can arrange, and Glyph shares.

- A song page tinted by its cover, timed or plain lyrics from LRCLIB or your own text, shuffle, repeat and a sleep timer.
- Play next and Add to queue from file menus; reorder or remove entries in the queue. Favorites and playlist reordering keep your library in reach.
- Glyph song, album and playlist shares resolve through bundled Cheek 0.2.2 and use the existing playlist picker. Official previews stay marked.
- Three mini player styles, dark/light/accent launcher icons, matching shortcuts and two new widgets for playback and pasting links.
- Restore hidden files in Settings, undo library deletions, and find a YouTube Music alternative for unavailable songs.
- Better audio-only file detection, quieter completion notifications while Hamstr is open, and playback that gives way to other apps.

Fixes include plain lyrics being replaced by the text `null`, stale audio queues after opening an image, and non-media files being mistaken for songs.

Signed APKs are available for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and all ABIs together. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
